opportunities.required_skills: Python, PyTorch, NumPy, Physics-Informed Neural Networks
opportunities.project_summary: Developing lightweight surrogate models for advection-diffusion equations in regional weather prediction. Comparing Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) against standard CNN baselines with an emphasis on physical conservation laws.
opportunities.project_title: Scientific ML Surrogates for Atmospheric Transport Models
opportunities.compensation_detail: $22/hour funded by national climate data initiative
opportunities.eligibility: Strong background in deep learning baselines and ODEs/PDEs
opportunities.mentor_support: Weekly structured check-ins, cloud GPU allocation (A100 instances), and support preparing findings for publication.

opportunities.required_skills: Python, Qiskit, Linear Algebra, Master Equations
opportunities.project_summary: Investigating decoherence mitigation in open quantum spin networks. The student will reproduce published Lindblad master-equation simulations, evaluate numerical stability under varying coupling strengths, and contribute to an open-source benchmark suite.
opportunities.project_title: Numerical Simulation of Open Quantum Spin Systems
opportunities.location_detail: Fully remote with weekly video meetings (UTC+1 to UTC+6)
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate or Master’s student with Python and quantum mechanics basics
opportunities.mentor_support: Weekly 1-on-1 supervision, dedicated Discord office hours, computational cluster access, and co-authorship opportunity if benchmarks are accepted.

opportunities.required_skills: R or Python, Seurat / Scanpy, Statistics, Data Visualization
opportunities.project_summary: Benchmarking trajectory-inference algorithms across public single-cell RNA-seq datasets of immune cell differentiation. You will evaluate reproducibility of published clusters and identify algorithmic sensitivity to preprocessing filters.
opportunities.project_title: Benchmarking Single-Cell Trajectory Reconstruction in Immune Cells
opportunities.location_detail: Hybrid or remote; core meetings in European time zones
opportunities.compensation_detail: Academic internship credit, compute resources provided
opportunities.eligibility: Familiarity with R or Python and foundational biology or bioinformatics
opportunities.mentor_support: Fortnightly review with senior postdoc, code review on GitHub, and guidance drafting a short conference abstract.
